text: Nadia weighed the two parcels. The lighter one rattled, so it had to be the cups.
Petra lit the small lamp. Its warm glow gave her a quiet sense of comfort.
Odile looked over the cart. One wheel wobbled and the axle was bent. She worked out that it had hit the kerb.
Bruno watched the tide gauge by the pier. He knew the ferry would be late.
Signe saw the child drop the cone. She remembered her own spilled milk.
Hale checked the pump. The dial read low and the pipe was cold. He worked out that the valve had stuck.
